summary:
Reviewed w138's one commit, e0ba985: the same content as 9277e80, which the implementer's result names, rebased. No change under features/, and no test removed or weakened. Allowances: none.
r72, r73 and r74 are implemented through a new supervise_draft.py, and workqueue.add gains retires/findings keywords.
Important, fix now: retires() compares accepted entries to tags by equality, so a range (cap#r3-r6, the usual form of real proposals' changes) retires none of its deprecated scenarios. That breaks r73 and departs from plan decision 4.
Minor observations: part_of None when the named work-item lacks it; only the first w<n> of a findings line is tried; questions given as one string are ignored.
tools check: ruff has one I001 at workqueue.py:235, in an import there before the commits; vulture is clean. tools size: nothing over 300.
